legacy_cells.B: Toward Intelligent AIoT: A Comprehensive Survey on Digital Twin and Multimodal Generative AI Integration
legacy_cells.C: Xiaoyi Luo; Aiwen Wang; Xinling Zhang; Kunda Huang; Songyu Wang; Lixin Chen; Yejia Cui
legacy_cells.I: 039_2025_Toward Intelligent AIoT A Comprehensive Survey on Digital Twin and Multimodal Generative AI Integration.pdf
legacy_cells.FM: The authors review DT–GAI integration across AIoT domains, propose a Sense–Map–Generate–Act framework, and consolidate mathematical models and evaluation indicators.
legacy_cells.FN: No new data or original model-evaluation results are reported; the authors state that no new data were created or analyzed.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors identify healthcare DT challenges including data security, interoperability, ethical concerns, and the complexity of modeling the human body; broader DT–GAI challenges include efficiency, reliability, privacy, and interoperability.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors identify future work on privacy-preserving computation and sustainability-aware optimization.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors describe DT–GAI integration research as fragmented and lacking a unified conceptual framework, systematic analysis, and rigorous evaluation metrics.
legacy_cells.FR: The SMGA loop, patient-specific care use cases, and adaptive control are described conceptually or in reviewed literature; this paper reports no new data or implementation-level clinical validation.
